extracted.intended_audience: potential nominators and members of the computing research community (those nominating or considering nominees for CRA awards)
extracted.subtask_description: Nomination criteria and descriptive guidance for multiple awards administered by the Computing Research Association (CRA), covering awards for diversity/participation efforts, early-career research impact, service to the computing research community and to CRA, undergraduate research excellence, and faculty mentoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: CRA A. Nico Habermann Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Award to a person who has made outstanding contributions aimed at increasing the numbers and/or successes of groups who have been marginalized in the computing research community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes work in areas of government affairs, educational programs, professional societies, public awareness, and leadership that has a major impact on advancing these groups in the computing research community. Recognized contributions can be focused directly at the research level or at its immediate precursors, namely students at the undergraduate or graduate levels. (Page links: View Awardees; Nomination Instructions.)

rubrics_metrics.name: CRA Anita Borg Early Career Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual award given to an individual who is relatively early in their career in computing research (whether in academia or industry/government research labs) who best exemplifies the spirit of Anita Borg.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidate should demonstrate significant contributions in research, as well as positive and significant impact on widening participation and improving access, opportunities, and positive experiences for all people in computing research and education. (Page links: View Awardees; Nomination Instructions.)

rubrics_metrics.name: CRA Distinguished Service Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Award, usually annual, to a person or organization that has made an outstanding service contribution to the computing research community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes service in areas of government affairs, professional societies, publications or conferences, and leadership that has a major impact on computing research. (Page links: View Awardees; Nomination Instructions.)

rubrics_metrics.name: CRA Outstanding Undergraduate Researchers Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Program recognizing undergraduate students in North American universities who show outstanding research potential in an area of computing research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets undergraduates with demonstrated strong research potential. (Page links: View Awardees; Nomination Instructions.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Service to CRA Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing outstanding service to CRA as an organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically honors notable service contributions directed to the Computing Research Association itself. (Page links: View Awardees.)

rubrics_metrics.name: CRA Skip Ellis Early Career Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual award given to an individual who is relatively early in their career in computing research who best exemplifies the spirit of Skip Ellis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Celebrates contributions in research and advocacy/efforts to increase participation of those marginalized in computing. Candidate should have significant contributions in research, and positive and significant impact on widening participation and improving access, opportunities, and positive experiences for all people in computing research and education. (Page links: View Awardees; Nomination Instructions.)

rubrics_metrics.name: CRA Undergraduate Research Faculty Mentoring Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing individual faculty members who have provided exceptional mentorship and undergraduate research experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also recognizes faculty who provide guidance on admission and matriculation of their undergraduate mentees to research-focused graduate programs in computing. (Page links: View Awardees; Nomination Instructions.)
